pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's lemma environment at source lines 24172-24183 (label lemma-torsion-completion, canonical tag 0BNK): if a ring map induces isomorphisms on the quotients by all powers of an ideal, then the base change of every power torsion module along that map is an isomorphism, with the completion of a finitely generated ideal as a special case. The proof environment at source lines 24185-24198 immediately follows it and is its own proof: for a module annihilated by a fixed power the base change is identified with the tensor product over the quotient against the base changed quotient and hence with the module itself, and an arbitrary power torsion module is written as the union of those submodules so that the result follows from commutation of the tensor product with direct limits, the completion case being a special case.
